name: xp-stack
description: Portable XP/Akita methodology for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI): absolute TDD, pair programming, formal research with triangulation, evidence-based task decomposition, policy-aware review, and optional native/headless/remote orchestration. Model, profile, and mechanism follow the current session/Host. Inspired by Reversa.

scripts.test:bash: bash tests/marketplace_test.sh && bash tests/skeleton_test.sh && bash tests/scaffold_test.sh && bash tests/bootstrap_test.sh && bash tests/paperclip_test.sh && bash tests/local_waves_test.sh
